summary: Wrote a 7-phase implementation plan for repo-scoped coordination of full gate-set runs. The design follows the research report's bounded-wait lease with mandatory fail-open, built on task-lock.sh's existing acquire_named_mutex primitive as a new .gate-lock family with gate-acquire/gate-release CLI siblings of commit-acquire/commit-release, bracketing tests/run-all.sh's top level and verify-deploy.sh's gate8_run() only. Plan adds four integration constraints verified in the source store at authoring time that research did not surface: the source-store task-lock.sh copy is uninvokable (deploy-root-guard.sh), run-all.sh's two existing branch EXIT traps would clobber a top-level release trap, a --only-narrowed run must not take the lock, and the new fixture suite must clear inherited RUN_ALL_NESTED/GATE_MUTEX_HELD. Final phase declares the complete gate set with an explicit source-store TARGET.

artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan: .gate-lock primitive and CLI, two call sites, fixture suite in two phases, documentation, redeploy plus full gate set.
